description: Change a page's URL: moves route `from` to `to`. Menu links and redirects to the old path retarget; a 301 stays at the old path (leaveRedirect). Draft HTML links to the old path are rewritten (linksRewritten; linksRewriteTruncated past 100 keys). rename_experiment_running: end the A/B test first; rename_target_exists is a 200 if `to` already serves it. Then publish_site.

leaveRedirect.description: Leave a 301 from the old path to the new one (default true); false removes the old path (old links break).

name: rename_page
